ideas.title: The rise of large-scale fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent surge in large-scale fraud cases in Minnesota, including the $250M COVID-19 child meals fraud scheme and the $46.6M Medicaid scheme indictment.
ideas.angle: The story would explore the causes and consequences of these fraud cases, as well as the efforts of law enforcement to combat them.
questions: What are the causes of the recent surge in large-scale fraud cases in Minnesota?
How are law enforcement agencies responding to these cases?
ideas.insight: The recent surge in large-scale fraud cases in Minnesota suggests a need for increased scrutiny and oversight of state and federal programs.
